title: DAY 9/90
VERBAL ABILITY
scenes.voice: Day nine of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge! One hundred and one days to go. Today we switch to General Aptitude, fifteen marks every paper carries.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is General Aptitude. Our topic: verbal ability, the English part of the paper.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover grammar and error spotting, vocabulary and word usage, sentence completion, verbal analogies and reading comprehension.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. With either or and neither nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject. Neither the teacher nor the students are late.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The free practice set with full explanations is waiting on Telegram. Tonight's verbal test runs seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 8 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day eight toppers! Rank one, Sweta Rani Sahoo, with a brilliant twenty two point six seven. Rank two, Atharva Vyas. Rank three, Akshay W. Congratulations to all three!
